name: deskpal
description: Playwright for the desktop — a C-native MCP server giving AI agents eyes and hands for any Linux desktop app

scripts.build:no-atspi: meson setup build-no-atspi --reconfigure -Datspi=disabled 2>/dev/null || meson setup build-no-atspi -Datspi=disabled; ninja -C build-no-atspi
scripts.build:asan: meson setup build-asan --reconfigure -Db_sanitize=address,undefined -Db_lundef=false 2>/dev/null || meson setup build-asan -Db_sanitize=address,undefined -Db_lundef=false; ninja -C build-asan
scripts.test:safe: python3 test/indicator_contract.py && python3 test/e2e_isolation.py && python3 test/e2e_computer_use.py && python3 test/e2e_accessibility.py
scripts.test:asan: npm run build:asan && ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0:abort_on_error=1 UBSAN_OPTIONS=halt_on_error=1:abort_on_error=1 DESKPAL_TEST_BINARY=$PWD/build-asan/deskpal npm run test:safe
scripts.test:live: sh -c 'status=0; npm run test:desktop || status=1; npm run test:sysmon || status=1; npm run test:indicator-live || status=1; exit $status'
